text: The Nominating Panel - Committee of Adjustment will recommend one candidate to City Council for appointment to the Committee of Adjustment from the list of candidates interviewed at the June 13, 2025 Nominating Panel - Committee of Adjustment meeting, to replace a previously recommended candidate who withdrew their candidacy on June 23, 2025.

The Nominating Panel - Committee of Adjustment recommends that: 1. City Council appoint the following candidate to the Toronto and East York Panel of the Committee of Adjustment for a term of office ending November 14, 2026, and until a successor is appointed: Dino Lombardi
